# UI Guidelines - Admin Panel (Minimal Flat)

## Design Philosophy

* Flat design
* No shadow
* Border-based layout
* Clean spacing
* Mobile-first

---

## Color Palette

### Primary

* Blue: #2563EB
* Light Blue: #DBEAFE

---

### Neutral

* Background: #F8FAFC
* Surface: #FFFFFF
* Border: #E5E7EB

---

### Text

* Primary: #111827
* Secondary: #6B7280

---

### Status

* Success: #16A34A
* Warning: #F59E0B
* Danger: #DC2626

---

## Layout

* Max width: 2xl
* Centered layout
* Padding: 16px
* Gap: 12–16px

---

## Components

### Card

* Background: white
* Border: 1px solid #E5E7EB
* Rounded: 16px
* Padding: 16px

---

### Button

* Height: 44px
* Rounded: 12px
* No shadow

Variants:

* Primary (blue)
* Secondary (gray)
* Danger (red)

---

### Input

* Height: 44px
* Border
* Rounded: 12px
* Padding: 12px

Label:

* Always visible above input

---

### List (Table replacement)

* Use card list
* Each item is a block

---

### Bottom Navigation

* Fixed bottom
* Max 5 items
* Icon + label

---

### Sheet (Modal replacement)

* Slide from bottom
* Full width
* Rounded top

---

## Interaction

* Tap area ≥ 44px
* No hover dependency
* Fast response

---

## Animation

* Simple only
* Duration: 150–200ms
* Use transform instead of height

---

## Do

* Use spacing for hierarchy
* Keep UI consistent
* Use color for emphasis

---

## Don't

* ❌ No shadow
* ❌ No heavy gradient
* ❌ No nested borders
* ❌ No complex animation
